MODULE_TEMPLATES.NAME: SMS Module
MODULE_TEMPLATES.DESCRIPTION: Manages SMS sending, campaign management, and password verification. Tracks messages waiting to be sent, maintains records of sent messages, manages message templates, and controls blocked phone numbers.
MODULE_TEMPLATES.DBML:
enum TemplateTypes {
  OTP [note: "One Time Password template"]
  INFO [note: "Informational template"]
  CAMPAIGN [note: "Marketing campaign template"]
}

enum MessageStatus {
  PENDING [note: "Queued and waiting to be sent"]
  SENT [note: "Successfully sent to provider"]
  FAILED [note: "Sending failed"]
  EXPIRED [note: "Expired and cannot be sent"]
  INVALID_RECIPIENT [note: "Invalid recipient address"]
  SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE [note: "SMS provider unavailable"]
  QUOTA_EXCEEDED [note: "Sending quota exceeded"]
  TIMEOUT [note: "Request timeout"]
  UNKNOWN [note: "Unknown error"]
}

enum BlacklistReasonType {
  SPAM [note: "Reported as spam"]
  UNSUBSCRIBED [note: "Unsubscribed from messages"]
  INVALID_ADDRESS [note: "Invalid phone number"]
  BOUNCED [note: "Message bounced"]
  MANUAL_BLOCK [note: "Manually blocked"]
}

  "STATUS" MessageStatus [not null]
  "ATTEMPT_COUNT" integer [not null, default: 0]

  "SENT_DATE" datetime [null]

    Query:GET_BY_ID[1] Where:ID
    Query:GET_BY_CAMPAIGN[] Where:CAMPAIGN_ID
    Query:GET_BY_STATUS[] Where:STATUS
    Query:GET_PENDING_MESSAGES[] Where:STATUS[PENDING]
    Query:GET_MESSAGES_COUNT[*] Where:CAMPAIGN_ID
    Query:GET_MESSAGES_WITH_CAMPAIGN[] Tables:MESSAGE M, CAMPAIGN C Where:C.IS_ACTIVE[true], M.STATUS[PENDING] Select:M.ID, M.RECIPIENT, C.NAME CAMPAIGN_NAME
    Update:UPDATE_STATUS Where:ID Set:STATUS
    Update:INCREMENT_ATTEMPT Where:ID Set:ATTEMPT_COUNT[+1]
  '''
}
